bug_semantics: The advisory combines two x-proxy-path trust failures. In the admin static handler, an unauthenticated request header was inserted verbatim into served HTML, JavaScript, and CSS; attacker syntax could therefore execute on the admin origin, and the absence of Vary/no-store let a URL-keyed intermediary cache distribute a poisoned representation. Separately, the legacy /p/:pad/timeslider route put a character-filtered but otherwise attacker-controlled proxy path at the start of a 302 Location. Because the filter retained slashes and did not collapse a leading //, x-proxy-path: //evil.example produced //evil.example/p/<pad>, which browsers resolve as a protocol-relative cross-origin redirect.
flaw_origin: Two independently introduced vulnerable sinks share the header. The non-AI admin sink was first written by 3e9c90e994d4af71ac8f49668f48caf61ef1b55d. The open-redirect sink was first written in the retained PR member f784c8c47c16e184b3ef3bdbf84485d4e5c42eb2 and then landed through squash 451bd9c3ebb0dded99dd0ff21811ee00e0940c29; f784c8c47c16e184b3ef3bdbf84485d4e5c42eb2 is the smallest AI-marked true BIC represented by the AuditResult SHA fields.
evidence: Admin origin and parent absence: `git log -L 72,87:src/node/hooks/express/admin.ts b96e262782e1ed72999c42cb47fb9140e58fe544` attributes the raw req.header(PROXY_HEADER) replaceAll lines to 3e9c90e994d4af71ac8f49668f48caf61ef1b55d (parent e6e1af58104b16a41fb500899e9a0bb50a7d1b85). `git show e6e1af58104b16a41fb500899e9a0bb50a7d1b85:src/node/hooks/express/admin.ts` shows the parent used express.static/sendFile and had no PROXY_HEADER read or body substitution. `git cat-file -p 3e9c90e994d4af71ac8f49668f48caf61ef1b55d` shows author SamTV12345, committer GitHub, subject 'Fixed proxying Etherpad with nginx. (#6388)', and no AI/bot/Generated-with/Co-Authored-By marker. The advisory-cited 63e9b2d4eb303cd341022591bdf9484584db36e3 does not touch admin.ts (`git show --stat`), so it is not this sink's BIC.

Open-redirect squash decomposition: retained PR head 609180ae778dcbd3536e3469617036e300172d7a exposes the pre-squash chain. `git log -S'`${proxyPath}/p/${encodeURIComponent(req.params.pad)}`' 609180ae778dcbd3536e3469617036e300172d7a -- src/node/hooks/express/specialpages.ts` and `git log -L 399,412:src/node/hooks/express/specialpages.ts 609180ae778dcbd3536e3469617036e300172d7a` both identify f784c8c47c16e184b3ef3bdbf84485d4e5c42eb2, not aggregate 451bd9c3ebb0dded99dd0ff21811ee00e0940c29, as the member that changed the safe relative `../${encodeURIComponent(req.params.pad)}` redirect to `${proxyPath}/p/${encodeURIComponent(req.params.pad)}`.

Direct open-redirect parent check: `git show c5a54cfd7b528186aca33aea971b7099ca468790:src/node/hooks/express/specialpages.ts` shows the immediate parent redirected only to `../${encodeURIComponent(req.params.pad)}` and did not place proxyPath in Location. `git show f784c8c47c16e184b3ef3bdbf84485d4e5c42eb2:src/node/hooks/express/specialpages.ts` shows the new proxyPath concatenation. At that commit the local sanitizeProxyPath returned `raw.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\-_\/\.]/g, '')`, which preserves a leading `//`; therefore the vulnerable protocol-relative Location exists in the child and not its direct parent.

BIC-only AI evidence: `git cat-file -p f784c8c47c16e184b3ef3bdbf84485d4e5c42eb2` gives sole parent c5a54cfd7b528186aca33aea971b7099ca468790, human author/committer John McLear <john@mclear.co.uk>, and the exact commit-message trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>`. No PR-body or later-commit signal is used for the verdict. This seven-line, one-file member is precisely the change that created the unsafe Location sink.

Landing boundary: `git show 451bd9c3ebb0dded99dd0ff21811ee00e0940c29 -- src/node/hooks/express/specialpages.ts` shows squash #7710 carrying the same proxyPath Location line onto the public branch. `git tag --contains 451bd9c3ebb0dded99dd0ff21811ee00e0940c29` starts at 3.0.0/v3.0.0, and `git show v3.0.0:src/package.json` reports ep_etherpad-lite version 3.0.0. `git show v3.0.0:src/node/hooks/express/specialpages.ts` contains the vulnerable redirect, so the open redirect first shipped in 3.0.0.

Admin version boundary: `git tag --contains 3e9c90e994d4af71ac8f49668f48caf61ef1b55d` starts at 2.1.0/v2.1.0; `git show v2.1.0:src/package.json` reports version 2.1.0. `git show v2.0.3:src/node/hooks/express/admin.ts` shows only express.static/sendFile and no x-proxy-path interpolation, while 3e9c90e994d4af71ac8f49668f48caf61ef1b55d adds the raw substitutions. Thus the admin issue begins in 2.1.0, predates the open redirect, and remains through 3.0.0.

Fix reconstruction: direct PR commit 714f66caa139849660fac3aa826b4dff2468e65e (parent b96e262782e1ed72999c42cb47fb9140e58fe544) adds shared src/node/utils/sanitizeProxyPath.ts, changes both sinks to use it, and adds Vary: x-proxy-path plus Cache-Control: private, no-store to admin responses. Its helper strips disallowed characters, collapses /^\/{2,}/ to one slash, forces an absolute single-slash prefix, and rejects `..` segments. Squash landing 8c6104c5d5daf41f0d454acc04d42dffa0e0d996 contains the same changes; `git show 8c6104c5d5daf41f0d454acc04d42dffa0e0d996 -- admin.ts specialpages.ts sanitizeProxyPath.ts` reproduces them.

Patched boundary: `git tag --contains 8c6104c5d5daf41f0d454acc04d42dffa0e0d996` starts at 3.1.0/v3.1.0, whereas 3.0.0 contains the vulnerable state. `git show v3.1.0:src/package.json` reports 3.1.0; its tagged sanitizeProxyPath.ts collapses multiple leading slashes, and tagged admin.ts uses the helper and cache headers. This corroborates affected ep_etherpad-lite >=2.1.0 through 3.0.0 and first patched 3.1.0, with the open-redirect subcase limited to 3.0.0.
reasoning: The advisory is a compound finding, so its two causal histories must not be conflated. The longstanding admin XSS/cache-poisoning branch is human-authored and has no BIC-object AI marker. For the open-redirect branch, the initial legacy redirect member 94995c1fa528879aca248955787b6fa97de32935 was relative and safe from proxy-header control; member f784c8c47c16e184b3ef3bdbf84485d4e5c42eb2 alone changed it to an absolute Location prefixed with a sanitizer output that could begin `//`. Its immediate parent proves absence, its commit object explicitly co-credits Claude, and the exact AI-marked change creates the attack primitive. That supports AI_ROOT_CAUSE for the AI-relevant open-redirect component without misattributing the separate admin component. The public squash and release tags establish shipment, while the direct fix member and its public squash establish closure.
